description: Na₆ZnO₄ crystallizes in the hexagonal P6₃mc space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.69 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ trigonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent ZnO₄ tetrahedra, corners with eight equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one ZnO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.51 Å. Zn is bonded to four O atoms to form ZnO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids and edges with three equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids. There is one shorter (1.97 Å) and three longer (2.00 Å) Zn-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to seven Na and one Zn atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to six Na and one Zn atom.
